from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """A Cash Flow from Investing Activities line item found in a financial statement."""
    entity_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the entity the filing belongs to")
    statement_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., three months ended March 31, 2024)")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the line item as written (e.g., 'Net cash used in investing activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported; negative if parentheses or negative sign present")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The magnitude of the unit (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text anchoring the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flows: list[InvestingCashFlow]
